name: dive-start
prompt: Short punchy pneumatic whoosh with a quick downward pitch sweep, like a pod launching into a shaft, dry, no reverb tail.

name: hover-release
prompt: Soft airy brake hiss with a gentle rising flutter, like a descent pod catching lift and hovering, short and clean.

name: crystal-break
prompt: Sharp glassy crystalline shatter, brittle high-frequency shards scattering, single decisive crack followed by tiny fragment tinkling.

name: gap-pass
prompt: Fast clean air whoosh, like a small object slipping through a narrow opening, brief rising swoosh with a light whistle.

name: overdrive-surge
prompt: Heavy metallic breach: a thick armor plate punched through with a deep crunchy slam, followed by an energetic electric surge swell.

name: charge-pip
prompt: Tiny bright mechanical click-blip, like an energy cell slotting into place with a soft electronic chirp, very short.

name: armor-crash
prompt: Violent metal-on-metal collision, a pod smashing into a solid armored wall, deep clang with rattling debris and a low rumble decay.

name: core-reached
prompt: Triumphant crystalline chime sequence: three rising bell-like tones ringing out as a reactor core breaks open, shimmering harmonic tail.

name: run-ended
prompt: Low mournful power-down, machinery winding to a stop with a falling pitch drone and a soft final clunk.

name: ui-tick
prompt: Very short dry UI tick, a soft plastic button tap with a subtle high click, neutral and unobtrusive.

name: achievement-unlock
prompt: Bright two-note badge-unlock jingle, small metallic chime followed by a higher sparkly chime, celebratory but compact.

name: countdown-beep
prompt: Single clean electronic countdown beep, medium pitch, short envelope, like a timer on a diving console.

name: undo-rewind
prompt: Short reversed air whoosh with a quick tape-rewind flutter ending in a soft mechanical snap into place, clean and dry, no reverb tail.

name: lesson-complete
prompt: Warm short confirmation chime: a soft glassy bell followed by a gentle upward resolving tone, calm and encouraging, brief with a light shimmer tail.

name: timer-warning
prompt: Urgent muffled reactor alarm: two quick low electronic klaxon pulses with a slight metallic resonance, short and tense, no tail.

name: new-best
prompt: Bright ascending three-note crystalline arpeggio with a soft sparkling shimmer on the last note, celebratory and compact.
